description:
This is a presolicitation notice of a future Request for Quote (RFQ N4215826QE020).  The RFQ will be posted on SAM.gov on or around March 16, 2026.  Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), Norfolk Naval Shipyard (NNSY) intends to post and award a Firm Fixed Price Single Award Contract as necessary to proivde Norfolk Naval Shipyard (NNSY) in Portsmouth, Virginia with a Calibrator Kit. 

This requirement will be acquired on an Other Than Full and Open basis, in accordance with FAR 12 using Simplified Acquisition Procedures.  The NAICS code for this item is 334519.  Do not bid on this item at this time.  Please wait until the officeial Solicitation/RFQ is posted.  That will be RFQ N4215826QE020. 

The requirement will be for one (1) Portable Pressure Calibrator Kit.  This is a brand name sole source item from King Nutronics Corporatrion.  The part number is 3750-4-1 .  A copy of the Continuation Sheet/Report is attached with a full description.
